description: A shell script containing test cases for a Git push operation, focusing on error scenarios related to missing hooks and atomic pushes. It includes command execution, output validation, and cleanup routines.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail; used for testing error scenarios.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes output for better readability and stability.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats and saves expected output for comparison.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output with expected output.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares Git references to verify repository state.
